description: Separate deterministic diagnostic set. It is not part of the measured 100-case benchmark. Labels come from the published rulebook. A mock run is simulated and is not model performance.
fact_policy: Fact values are fixed in the spec table. Only identity lines use the id seed.

counterfactual_pairs.note: Exactly 90 kPa is not a pressure hold.
Exactly 3 percent is not a weight review. Held-out misses sent some of these exact-boundary CLEAR cases to REVIEW.
A damaged seal is HOLD even when another field conflicts.
The explicit status not-on-file is known. An unknown certificate status is a missing required fact.
A valid emergency waiver clears singing cargo only when the certificate is absent and the hazard is not class 4.
Class 4 acoustic cargo is excluded from the waiver exception and is not an automatic hold by itself.
A waiver does not bypass a damaged seal.
A waiver does not bypass a weight discrepancy above 3 percent.
Pressure below 90 is still HOLD when another required fact is unknown. Exactly 90 leaves that missing fact as REVIEW.
Observed held-out REVIEW to CLEAR misses: Drex cleared singing cargo with a valid waiver while a weight contradiction remained.
Observed held-out REVIEW to CLEAR misses: OpenRouter cleared packets whose hazard class was unknown.
Observed held-out CLEAR to REVIEW miss: an expired certificate on non-singing cargo is still CLEAR. Singing cargo with that certificate and an unknown waiver is REVIEW.

single_cases.note: Class 4 acoustic cargo is not an automatic hold.
A corrected historical suspicion is not a confirmed damaged seal.
A valid certificate means waiver status is not required.
An explicit not-on-file waiver is known and is not a valid waiver.
Certificate gross weight is required when a certificate exists.
Unknown pressure is a missing required fact, not a pressure hold.
Unknown seal condition is a missing required fact.
Unknown manifest weight is a missing required fact.

live_policy: Mock is the offline default. A live run requires benchmark_decisions.py --hard --confirm-live and stops when the configured Drex or OpenRouter budget would be exceeded.
